sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 这里是《纽约时报》的《访谈》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: This week I sat down with Jenna Ortega.
sentences.zh: 本周我采访了珍娜·奥尔特加。

sentences.en: And if you have a tween daughter like I do, this is a very big deal.
sentences.zh: 如果你像我一样有个十几岁的女儿，这可是件大事。

sentences.en: In 2022, Ortega starred as the title character in Wednesday, the Addams Family reboot produced by Tim Burton for Netflix.
sentences.zh: 2022年，奥尔特加在蒂姆·波顿为Netflix制作的《星期三》中饰演同名主角，这是《亚当斯一家》的重启之作。

sentences.en: And she became an instant hero to both kids and adults like me, who adored her snarky, dark, and brutally honest personality.
sentences.zh: 她瞬间成为了孩子们和像我这样的大人们心中的英雄，我们都爱极了她那种尖酸、阴郁且极其坦率的性格。

sentences.en: Suddenly Wednesday, and by extension, Ortega, was everywhere.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，《星期三》以及随之而来的奥尔特加，无处不在。

sentences.en: On merch, Halloween costumes, all over the internet doing her endlessly memeable dance moves.
sentences.zh: 周边商品、万圣节服装，互联网上到处都是她那极具模仿性的舞蹈动作。

sentences.en: It was the kind of star-making, culture-saturating event that is life-changing for a young actor.
sentences.zh: 这是一种造星级的、席卷文化的事件，对年轻演员来说是改变人生的大事。

sentences.en: But Ortega didn't just suddenly appear out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 但奥尔特加并不是突然凭空出现的。

sentences.en: She's been working since she was a kid herself, on the Disney Channel and in shows like Jane the Virgin.
sentences.zh: 她从孩提时代就开始演戏了，在迪士尼频道和《处女情缘》等剧中都有出演。

sentences.en: As an adult, she's also become a regular in the horror world, starring in both the Scream and X franchises.
sentences.zh: 成年后，她也成了恐怖片界的常客，主演了《惊声尖叫》和《X》系列电影。

sentences.en: Ortega is 21 now, and her next big role is in the new movie Beetlejuice, Beetlejuice, the sequel to Burton's 1988 classic, where she plays the daughter of Winona Ryder's character.
sentences.zh: 奥尔特加现在21岁，她的下一个重要角色是新片《阴间大法师2》，这是波顿1988年经典之作的续集，她在片中饰演薇诺娜·瑞德角色的女儿。

sentences.en: When I caught up with her, she was filming the second season of Wednesday in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 我见到她时，她正在爱尔兰拍摄《星期三》第二季。

sentences.en: We talked about her time as a child actor, her Latina roots, her upcoming projects, and her newfound fame.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了她的童星生涯、拉丁裔根源、未来的项目以及她新获得的声望。

sentences.en: And what came across is that Ortega is a deeply thoughtful and curious person, who, like many young people, is still trying to find out who she is,
sentences.zh: 显而易见，奥尔特加是一个非常有思想且充满好奇心的人，像许多年轻人一样，她仍在努力寻找自我，

sentences.en: all while dealing with the glare of a massive spotlight.
sentences.zh: 同时还要应对聚光灯下的强烈关注。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Jenna Ortega.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与珍娜·奥尔特加的对话。

sentences.en: Before we talk about the Beetlejuice film, I wanted to ask you just a little bit about what your life is like when you're filming in a place that you're not familiar with.
sentences.zh: 在聊《阴间大法师》之前，我想问问你在不熟悉的地方拍戏时，生活是什么样的。

sentences.en: I mean, do you hang out with your co-stars?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你会和联合主演一起出去玩吗？

sentences.en: Do you just focus on your work?
sentences.zh: 还是只专注于工作？

sentences.en: Like, what is the vibe day to day?
sentences.zh: 平时的生活氛围是怎样的？

sentences.en: Well, currently, I'm working on being better about hanging out or prioritizing a normal life outside of work because I typically just hide away in a hole
sentences.zh: 嗯，目前我正在努力改善社交，或者说优先考虑工作之外的正常生活，因为我通常只是躲在洞里，

sentences.en: and lose all sense of self and life outside of my job.
sentences.zh: 失去了对自我和工作之外生活的感知。

sentences.en: And I don't do that intentionally, and that's not to be dramatic.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意的，也不是为了显得戏剧化。

sentences.en: But I think it's really easy on a job where, for example, I do a lot of horror and things like that.
sentences.zh: 但我认为在某些工作中，比如我经常拍恐怖片之类的，这很容易发生。

sentences.en: There's a lot of night shoots.
sentences.zh: 有很多夜戏。

sentences.en: You know, you're not working regular hours.
sentences.zh: 你知道，工作时间不规律。

sentences.en: It's kind of hard to communicate with people during the day because you're technically supposed to be sleeping.
sentences.zh: 白天很难和人交流，因为按理说你应该在睡觉。

sentences.en: Me working on location usually consists of walking around for a bit, maybe going for a run,
sentences.zh: 我在外地工作通常就是到处走走，也许去跑个步，

sentences.en: finding like a local cafe that I know I like the coffee there.
sentences.zh: 找一家我喜欢的当地咖啡馆。

sentences.en: And then that's about it.
sentences.zh: 差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: I usually find a nice river and a park bench to write on.
sentences.zh: 我通常会找一条漂亮的河流和一张公园长椅来写东西。

sentences.en: And you like to journal.
sentences.zh: 你喜欢写日记。

sentences.en: Yes, I love to.
sentences.zh: 是的，我非常喜欢。

sentences.en: Tell me a little bit about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说这个吧。

sentences.en: Like, why did you get started doing that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么开始写日记的？

sentences.en: And what do you journal about?
sentences.zh: 你都记些什么？

sentences.en: Well, I got into that because I lost a sense of self in life while I started working and traveling for the first time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我开始写是因为我第一次开始工作和旅行时，失去了对生活的自我感知。

sentences.en: Because I first started traveling when I was around 18, so it's been a few years of this.
sentences.zh: 因为我大约18岁才开始旅行，所以这已经持续几年了。

sentences.en: Because I love to journal about my dreams mainly.
sentences.zh: 因为我主要喜欢记录我的梦。

sentences.en: Oh, really?
sentences.zh: 哦，真的吗？

sentences.en: Yes, because dreams to me are really fascinating because I feel like I learned a lot about myself through them.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为对我来说梦非常迷人，我觉得通过梦我了解了很多关于自己的事情。

sentences.en: I've been able to notice patterns in my way of thinking based on how stressed I may be, lack of sleep.
sentences.zh: 我能够根据自己的压力程度、睡眠不足的情况，注意到自己思维模式中的规律。

sentences.en: Sometimes I end up in this middle state where I'm actually inspired and become creative over the ideas that I had while I was still somewhat awake.
sentences.zh: 有时我会进入一种中间状态，实际上会受到启发，并根据我半梦半醒时的想法进行创作。

sentences.en: And sometimes it's complete nonsense.
sentences.zh: 有时则完全是胡言乱语。

sentences.en: None of it makes sense.
sentences.zh: 一点逻辑都没有。

sentences.en: It'll be balloons made out of frogs.
sentences.zh: 比如青蛙做的气球之类的。

sentences.en: Like, it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 这不重要。

sentences.en: But other times it'll be a really special story.
sentences.zh: 但有时也会出现非常特别的故事。

sentences.en: It's cool that you remember it, though.
sentences.zh: 你能记住这些真的很酷。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Okay, let's talk about the movie.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们来聊聊这部电影。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: When did you first see the original Beetlejuice?
sentences.zh: 你第一次看原版《阴间大法师》是什么时候？

sentences.en: Honestly, I can't really put a date on it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我记不清具体日期了。

sentences.en: I feel like I had to have seen it maybe when I was around eight or nine.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我大概八九岁的时候看过。

sentences.en: I was terrified of everything when I was younger.
sentences.zh: 我小时候对什么都感到恐惧。

sentences.en: I actually had a reoccurring nightmare about Beetlejuice.
sentences.zh: 我甚至做过关于阴间大法师的噩梦。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, but I think I actually got scared because I saw a really terrible Halloween costume before I really knew what the movie was.
sentences.zh: 是的，但我认为我被吓到是因为在了解这部电影之前，我看到过一套非常可怕的万圣节服装。

sentences.en: And I think that the mold and smearing, like, bleeding green and black Party City makeup gave me a scare.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那种发霉的、涂抹的、流着绿黑色的派对城化妆品把我吓坏了。

sentences.en: Anyway, I just remember that image.
sentences.zh: 总之，我只记得那个形象。

sentences.en: And then I watched the movie later and I thought, oh, man, this is what the guy was dressed as.
sentences.zh: 后来我看了电影，心想，天哪，原来那个人装扮的是这个。

sentences.en: This is just as scary.
sentences.zh: 这简直一样吓人。

sentences.en: So yeah, I think around then.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想大概就是那时候。

sentences.en: What were your nightmares about Beetlejuice?
sentences.zh: 你关于阴间大法师的噩梦是什么样的？

sentences.en: I shared a room my entire life growing up.
sentences.zh: 我从小到大一直和人合住一个房间。

sentences.en: And I was the bottom bunk on a bunk bed.
sentences.zh: 我睡在双层床的下铺。

sentences.en: And I had a dream that Beetlejuice would come down and swing around the banister down to my bunk wearing a Superman cape and would offer me grape juice.
sentences.zh: 我梦见阴间大法师走下来，顺着栏杆滑到我的铺位，穿着超人斗篷，还要给我葡萄汁。

sentences.en: And he would say, got any grape?
sentences.zh: 他会说，有葡萄汁吗？

sentences.en: Did you tell this to Michael Keaton when you met him?
sentences.zh: 你见到迈克尔·基顿的时候跟他说过吗？

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 没有，没有。

sentences.en: Maybe I should have, but maybe there was something in me that was still potentially scared and frightened.
sentences.zh: 也许我应该说，但也许我内心深处仍然感到害怕和恐惧。

sentences.en: You know, it's meeting him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是见到他本人。

sentences.en: It was a giant from your childhood.
sentences.zh: 那是你童年时代的一个巨人。

sentences.en: That's intimidating.
sentences.zh: 这很吓人。

sentences.en: And I think I just, maybe I reverted back to my old adolescent ways in front of him.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能在他面前又变回了小时候的样子。

sentences.en: I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 我不确定。

sentences.en: You know, one of the things that I love about Beetlejuice is that it's a film that is full of joy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我喜欢《阴间大法师》的一点是，它是一部充满欢乐的电影。

sentences.en: It's not like the scary view of the afterlife, despite what you felt as an eight-year-old.
sentences.zh: 尽管你八岁时有那种感觉，但它并不是对死后世界的恐怖描绘。

sentences.en: I can understand that.
sentences.zh: 我能理解。

sentences.en: But it is sort of this kind of funky,
sentences.zh: 但它确实是一种时髦的、

sentences.en: not terribly dark view of death.
sentences.zh: 对死亡并不那么阴暗的看法。

sentences.en: Well, Tim Burton is obviously a master.
sentences.zh: 嗯，蒂姆·波顿显然是一位大师。

sentences.en: And I think he's done an incredible job all throughout his career of being able to balance dark topics that most people are, I guess, fearful of or avoidant of
sentences.zh: 我认为他在整个职业生涯中都做得非常出色，能够平衡大多数人感到恐惧或回避的黑暗话题，

sentences.en: and make it an acceptable and almost comforting conversation.
sentences.zh: 并使之成为一种可接受且近乎安慰的对话。

sentences.en: So it's something like Beetlejuice.
sentences.zh: 所以像《阴间大法师》这样的作品。

sentences.en: You know, you see people reconnecting with loved ones.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你看到人们与亲人重逢。

sentences.en: You see people finding love.
sentences.zh: 你看到人们找到真爱。

sentences.en: You see people making discoveries about themselves.
sentences.zh: 你看到人们发现自我。

sentences.en: It's actually beautifully put, you know, the afterlife rather than hell or something like that, you know, because it's just, it continues.
sentences.zh: 这其实表达得很美，你知道，死后世界而不是地狱之类的，因为它只是在继续。

sentences.en: And I think for a lot of people who maybe don't consider death or for young children who can't really understand the concept, I think it's a really easy guide.
sentences.zh: 对于许多可能没考虑过死亡的人，或者无法理解这个概念的幼儿来说，我认为这是一个非常简单的指南。

sentences.en: And also just the idea that they're not gone, right?
sentences.zh: 还有就是他们并没有真正离开的想法，对吧？

sentences.en: That you can find them afterwards.
sentences.zh: 你可以在之后找到他们。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Do you believe in life after death?
sentences.zh: 你相信死后有生命吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不信。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不信。

sentences.en: I wish.
sentences.zh: 我希望有。

sentences.en: I wish.
sentences.zh: 我希望有。

sentences.en: I wish that I could go and end up in, you know, Tim's version of the afterlife, but I don't.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能去到蒂姆版本的死后世界，但我并不这么认为。

sentences.en: I really think it just goes black afterwards.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得之后就是一片漆黑。

sentences.en: I think it's nice and comforting to think otherwise, but.
sentences.zh: 我觉得往别处想会让人感到安慰，但是。

sentences.en: I'm shocked.
sentences.zh: 我很震惊。

sentences.en: Do you?
sentences.zh: 你相信吗？

sentences.en: Well, yeah, this is the thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是这样的。

sentences.en: You know, as a Latina, I grew up believing in ghosts.
sentences.zh: 你知道，作为拉丁裔，我从小就相信有鬼魂。

sentences.en: I had a family member see them.
sentences.zh: 我有家人见过他们。

sentences.en: You know, my sister, when we were young, was always like, don't you see the, you know, the ghost there?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我姐姐小时候总是说，你没看到那里的鬼魂吗？

sentences.en: And I'd be like, no, man, I really don't.
sentences.zh: 我会说，不，伙计，我真的没看到。

sentences.en: And you're freaking me out.
sentences.zh: 你吓死我了。

sentences.en: But it's something that is embedded in the way I grew up.
sentences.zh: 但这已经融入了我的成长方式中。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't want to say that ghosts aren't real because I don't want one to come after me.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我不想说鬼魂不是真的，因为我不想被它们缠上。

sentences.en: And I also have people who claim that they saw ghosts.
sentences.zh: 而且我也有朋友声称他们见过鬼。

sentences.en: I'm sure there's some weird spiritual in-between realm.
sentences.zh: 我相信肯定存在某种奇怪的精神中间领域。

sentences.en: I do believe in kind of strong energies and things like that.
sentences.zh: 我确实相信某种强大的能量之类的东西。

sentences.en: But ultimately, I don't know, life is, there's a lot going on.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我不知道，生活，有很多事情在发生。

sentences.en: I would hope that you get some good rest afterwards.
sentences.zh: 我希望你之后能好好休息。

sentences.en: Also, so much of ghost culture, feels so strange to say, I think especially in the Latin community is based off of, you know, it's very religious.
sentences.zh: 而且，鬼魂文化中很大一部分，说出来感觉很奇怪，我觉得特别是在拉丁社区，是非常宗教化的。

sentences.en: Very.
sentences.zh: 非常宗教化。

sentences.en: So I think some of that is maybe to instill fear in young people.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为其中一些可能是在给年轻人灌输恐惧。

sentences.en: Or we just love to take the piss out of everything and harass one another in the most loving way.
sentences.zh: 或者我们只是喜欢拿一切开玩笑，以最亲爱的方式互相捉弄。

sentences.en: So I think also to tuck your kids in at night and tell them to watch out for La Llorona.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得晚上哄孩子睡觉时告诉他们小心“哭泣女”（La Llorona）也是为了这个。

sentences.en: Like, that's classic.
sentences.zh: 这很经典。

sentences.en: I think that's hilarious.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这太搞笑了。

sentences.en: I would do the same with my children.
sentences.zh: 我也会对我的孩子做同样的事。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think you're right.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我想你是对的。

sentences.en: And since we're talking about your childhood, I want to talk a little bit about that because you grew up in Coachella Valley.
sentences.zh: 既然我们在聊你的童年，我想多谈谈这个，因为你是在科切拉谷长大的。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I would love for you to tell me a little bit about what you remember from those early days.
sentences.zh: 我很想让你跟我说说你对早年生活的一些记忆。

sentences.en: I, looking back on it, had a pretty cool childhood.
sentences.zh: 回首往事，我度过了一个很酷的童年。

sentences.en: I grew up in a very loving household.
sentences.zh: 我在一个非常有爱的家庭中长大。

sentences.en: My parents are very in love with each other.
sentences.zh: 我的父母非常相爱。

sentences.en: I'm one of six kids, so I'm the fourth.
sentences.zh: 我有六个兄弟姐妹，我是老四。

sentences.en: And there's a pair of twins under me.
sentences.zh: 我下面还有一对双胞胎。

sentences.en: Who did you share your room with?
sentences.zh: 你和谁共用一个房间？

sentences.en: I shared my room with my older sister, Mia, for the longest time.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，我和我大姐米娅住一个房间。

sentences.en: And then when my older sister left, Mia got her room.
sentences.zh: 后来我大姐搬走了，米娅就搬进了她的房间。

sentences.en: And then my younger sister came into play.
sentences.zh: 然后我妹妹也加入了进来。

sentences.en: So there was no escape for me.
sentences.zh: 所以我根本没法逃避。

sentences.en: I didn't have my own room until I left.
sentences.zh: 直到我搬走之前，我都没有自己的房间。

sentences.en: But that was nice too, especially as someone who,
sentences.zh: 但那段时光也很美好，尤其是对我这样的人来说，

sentences.en: I would tuck myself in my blanket and I would cover my entire face except for my nose and lips so I could still breathe.
sentences.zh: 我会把自己裹在毯子里，把整张脸都盖住，只露出鼻子和嘴唇，这样我还能呼吸。

sentences.en: And I would wake up in a pile of sweat.
sentences.zh: 然后我会在一身汗中醒来。

sentences.en: I slept on like the wooden plank in between the bed and the wall.
sentences.zh: 我当时睡在床和墙之间那块木板上。

sentences.en: So when I would wake up in the middle of the night in a panic because I had a terrible nightmare,
sentences.zh: 所以每当我在半夜因为做了噩梦而惊醒时，

sentences.en: I could always look over and see my sister and think, oh, okay, cool.
sentences.zh: 我总能转过头看到我姐姐，然后心想，哦，好吧，没事了。

sentences.en: So did you have a lot of middle child energy being the fourth one?
sentences.zh: 那你作为老四，身上有很多“中间孩子”的特质吗？

sentences.en: No, I feel like I actually kind of had not the opposite.
sentences.zh: 不，我觉得我反而有点相反。

sentences.en: I mean, I was loud and extroverted and all of my family was very shy.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我很吵闹、外向，而我家里所有人都很害羞。

sentences.en: And my parents always said that I had the most expression and it made, you know, trips to Disneyland or something like that worth it
sentences.zh: 我父母总说我表现力最强，这让去迪士尼乐园之类的旅行变得很值得，

sentences.en: because where my siblings would walk around going, oh, okay, that's nice.
sentences.zh: 因为当我的兄弟姐妹走来走去说“哦，好吧，挺好的”时，

sentences.en: I was walking around going, oh my God, can you believe it?
sentences.zh: 我走来走去会说“天哪，你敢相信吗？”

sentences.en: Ariel waved at me.
sentences.zh: 爱丽儿刚才跟我招手了。

sentences.en: She saw me.
sentences.zh: 她看到我了。

sentences.en: This is the happiest place on earth.
sentences.zh: 这是世界上最快乐的地方。

sentences.en: I get it.
sentences.zh: 我懂那种感觉。

sentences.en: You know, I was very much that,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我就是那种人，

sentences.en: which I don't think is very middle child of me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这不太像“中间孩子”的作风。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: And your dad was a sheriff.
sentences.zh: 你父亲是警长。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And your mom was an emergency room nurse.
sentences.zh: 你母亲是急诊室护士。

sentences.en: Did that sort of rub off on you?
sentences.zh: 这会对你产生潜移默化的影响吗？

sentences.en: You know, those very intense jobs that deal with really important things, life or death matters.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那些处理重要事务、生死攸关的高压工作。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I love my parents.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的父母。

sentences.en: I love my mom.
sentences.zh: 我爱我妈妈。

sentences.en: She made me think I was going to die with every left turn that I took.
sentences.zh: 她让我觉得我每次向左转都可能会死。

sentences.en: Her fear of life and what would happen when we walked out.
sentences.zh: 她对生活以及我们出门后会发生什么的恐惧。

sentences.en: She'll even say it herself.
sentences.zh: 她自己也会这么说。

sentences.en: She's very fear-based and she moves based on her fears, which is totally understandable considering the job and the horrific phone calls she's had to make
sentences.zh: 她非常容易恐惧，她的行动都基于恐惧，考虑到她的工作以及她必须打出的那些可怕的电话，这完全可以理解，

sentences.en: or things that she's had to see.
sentences.zh: 或者她不得不亲眼目睹的事情。

sentences.en: It's unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 简直难以置信。

sentences.en: She has unbelievable stories.
sentences.zh: 她有讲不完的惊人故事。

sentences.en: But I wouldn't want to go outside for weeks.
sentences.zh: 但我有好几周都不想出门。

sentences.en: I had to go to school and I would beg her, please don't make me go because I thought that I was going to walk out and I was going to get hit by a car instantly
sentences.zh: 我得去上学，我会求她，求你别让我去，因为我觉得我一走出去就会立刻被车撞，

sentences.en: or I was going to trip and fall and bang all my teeth out.
sentences.zh: 或者我会绊倒，把牙齿全磕掉。

sentences.en: I didn't want to pet a dog because I thought a dog was going to bite my face.
sentences.zh: 我不想摸狗，因为我觉得狗会咬我的脸。

sentences.en: You know, I just didn't know what was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只是不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: And I definitely was, and still am, to a certain point, paranoid.
sentences.zh: 我确实曾经，而且在某种程度上现在依然，是个偏执狂。

sentences.en: I'm just very cautious of my surroundings and the people around me.
sentences.zh: 我只是对周围的环境和人非常谨慎。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I imagine that's true because, you know, if your mother's been seeing all this stuff, you know, she's going to worry that that's going to happen to you.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我能想象这是真的，因为如果你母亲一直目睹这些事情，她会担心这些事发生在你身上。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Did she tell you about it?
sentences.zh: 她会告诉你这些吗？

sentences.en: Did she come home and talk to you about it?
sentences.zh: 她回家后会跟你谈论这些吗？

sentences.en: She would.
sentences.zh: 她会。

sentences.en: And that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 这就是重点。

sentences.en: She would explain things in detail, which is why I think with the job that I do, it's kind of helped because while I was fearful of it then,
sentences.zh: 她会详细解释这些事情，这就是为什么我认为这对我现在的工作有帮助，因为虽然当时我很害怕，

sentences.en: I also was simultaneously being very desensitized to things.
sentences.zh: 但我同时也对这些事情变得非常麻木。

sentences.en: So I was never really scared by blood or gore, but I think that kind of helped.
sentences.zh: 所以我从不害怕血腥或暴力，我认为这反而有帮助。

sentences.en: Your first lead came when you landed the Disney show Stuck in the Middle.
sentences.zh: 你第一次担任主角是在出演迪士尼剧集《左右不逢源》的时候。

sentences.en: And then you were a voice actor in the animated Disney show Elena of Avalor, which I will say is my daughter's favorite.
sentences.zh: 后来你又在迪士尼动画剧集《艾琳娜公主》中担任配音，我得说那是我女儿的最爱。

sentences.en: First Latina princess.
sentences.zh: 第一位拉丁裔公主。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you played her younger sister, who's also a princess.
sentences.zh: 你饰演了她的妹妹，也是一位公主。

sentences.en: Do you remember the significance of being part of that show?
sentences.zh: 你还记得参与那部剧的意义吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, most definitely.
sentences.zh: 记得，当然记得。

sentences.en: When I initially was trying to convince my parents to let me act,
sentences.zh: 当我最初试图说服父母让我去演戏时，

sentences.en: I remember crying to them one night at the dinner table and just saying, oh man, I can do it.
sentences.zh: 我记得有天晚上在餐桌旁哭着对他们说，天哪，我能做到的。

sentences.en: I know I can do it.
sentences.zh: 我知道我能做到。

sentences.en: If you let me do it, I swear to you, I will end up on Disney Channel.
sentences.zh: 如果你们让我去，我向你们发誓，我一定会出现在迪士尼频道上。

sentences.en: And they just kind of laughed.
sentences.zh: 他们只是笑了笑。

sentences.en: So that was a huge marker of success for me when I was really young, just because I had met my promise.
sentences.zh: 所以那对我小时候来说是一个巨大的成功标志，仅仅是因为我兑现了我的承诺。

sentences.en: So I, you know, I completed my task.
sentences.zh: 所以我完成了我的任务。

sentences.en: And then with Elena of Avalor, I was doing Stuck in the Middle at the time.
sentences.zh: 后来在《艾琳娜公主》时期，我当时正在拍《左右不逢源》。

sentences.en: So I was a familiar face to Disney kids.
sentences.zh: 所以我对迪士尼的孩子们来说是一张熟悉的面孔。

sentences.en: So Disney Channel actually flew me out to Orlando, to Disney World, to promote the Disney princess in the park.
sentences.zh: 因此迪士尼频道真的把我送到了奥兰多的迪士尼乐园，去宣传公园里的迪士尼公主。

sentences.en: And I remember almost being brought to tears.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时差点热泪盈眶。

sentences.en: And my mom was definitely crying because we saw Elena, you know, walk through the park for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈肯定哭了，因为我们第一次看到艾琳娜在公园里走动。

sentences.en: And there was girls of all different ages and colors dressed in her outfit.
sentences.zh: 到处都是不同年龄、不同肤色的女孩穿着她的衣服。

sentences.en: And that, to us, was such a glorious moment because it was all,
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，那是一个如此辉煌的时刻，因为那正是，

sentences.en: all I wanted growing up was somebody that I could relate to.
sentences.zh: 我成长过程中一直想要的，就是有一个我能产生共鸣的人。

sentences.en: And, you know, I loved princesses and I wanted to be able to see myself in them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我喜欢公主，我希望能在她们身上看到自己的影子。

sentences.en: I wanted to be Cinderella so bad, but I didn't have blonde hair and that killed me.
sentences.zh: 我太想成为灰姑娘了，但我没有金发，这让我很难过。

sentences.en: You know, so something like Elena, we, I mean, I was so little when that happened.
sentences.zh: 所以像艾琳娜这样的角色，我们，我是说，那件事发生时我还很小。

sentences.en: I think I must have been 10 when I was first cast, but I knew the significance then and I definitely didn't take it for granted.
sentences.zh: 我想我刚被选中时才10岁，但我当时就明白其中的意义，而且我绝对没有把它视为理所当然。

sentences.en: Your parents were very supportive, but they weren't like stage parents, right?
sentences.zh: 你的父母很支持你，但他们不是那种“星爸星妈”，对吧？

sentences.en: At all.
sentences.zh: 完全不是。

sentences.en: They weren't kind of pushing you out there.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有强迫你去做什么。

sentences.en: It sounds like it came all from you.
sentences.zh: 听起来这完全是你自己的意愿。

sentences.en: What was the dynamic like, especially among other sort of families who's, you know, who really wanted their kids to become stars?
sentences.zh: 那种动态是怎样的？特别是在其他那些真的非常希望孩子成为明星的家庭面前？

sentences.en: You know, when I first started auditioning, these, we had spent hours in these casting offices and we met so many strange and intense personalities.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我刚开始试镜时，我们在选角办公室里待了几个小时，遇到了很多奇怪且强势的人。

sentences.en: It could be stage parents.
sentences.zh: 可能是星爸星妈。

sentences.en: It could be producers that really made me fearful of other people for a while.
sentences.zh: 也可能是制片人，他们一度让我对其他人感到恐惧。

sentences.en: And I think that that's when I kind of started to become more introverted, but it was such a joy to be able to get back in the car at the end of the day and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想就是在那时我开始变得更加内向，但每天结束时能回到车里，你知道，

sentences.en: just do my homework because I was still going to public school at the time and listen to my mom talk and catch up with my siblings at home.
sentences.zh: 做做作业，因为我当时还在上公立学校，听我妈妈说话，和家里的兄弟姐妹叙叙旧，这真是一种快乐。

sentences.en: When I was on that Disney Channel show, my mom was so calm and relaxed.
sentences.zh: 当我在拍那部迪士尼剧集时，我妈妈非常冷静和放松。

sentences.en: She went back to school.
sentences.zh: 她回学校读书了。

sentences.en: She got her bachelor's degree in that time.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里她拿到了学士学位。

sentences.en: And she took advantage of that time that she, those, all those hours she spent with me on set.
sentences.zh: 她利用了那些她在片场陪我的时间。

sentences.en: I was just very lucky because it was, it felt very normal.
sentences.zh: 我真的很幸运，因为一切感觉都很正常。

sentences.en: I was in school.
sentences.zh: 我在上学。

sentences.en: She was in school.
sentences.zh: 她在上学。

sentences.en: I mean, hey, you want to grab dinner afterwards?
sentences.zh: 我是说，嘿，之后想去吃晚饭吗？

sentences.en: Everything was very cozy and close.
sentences.zh: 一切都非常温馨和亲密。

sentences.en: And I knew that no matter who I was surrounded by or who I was with, my mom was, was there right by my side the whole time.
sentences.zh: 我知道无论我被谁包围，或者和谁在一起，我妈妈一直都在我身边。

sentences.en: What do you mean when you say that it made you afraid of other people, the kind of personalities that you would meet?
sentences.zh: 你说它让你害怕其他人，你指的是你遇到的那些人吗？

sentences.en: Because we were so brand new to everything and some of these people had been in it for years at the time
sentences.zh: 因为我们对一切都非常陌生，而当时有些人已经在这一行待了很多年，

sentences.en: or every kid in that family was an actor or, you know, all of these people had, you know, advice and experience and lessons.
sentences.zh: 或者那个家庭里的每个孩子都是演员，你知道，这些人都有建议、经验和教训。

sentences.en: And I didn't know anything about Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 而我对好莱坞一无所知。

sentences.en: I didn't know anyone, you know, and I wanted to be able to do things at my own pace and in my own style.
sentences.zh: 我不认识任何人，我想按照自己的节奏和风格去做事。

sentences.en: But, you know, you didn't know if people were saying things to help you or to hurt you.
sentences.zh: 但是，你不知道人们说的话是为了帮你还是害你。

sentences.en: And not even on that show, just speaking about my career as a child.
sentences.zh: 甚至不是在那部剧里，只是谈论我作为童星的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Overall, there was definitely a few moments where you realized, oh, maybe that person didn't have my best interest, you know.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，确实有几个时刻让你意识到，哦，也许那个人并没有为我着想。

sentences.en: Oh, maybe they didn't, you know, want to be as supportive of me as they said.
sentences.zh: 哦，也许他们并不像他们说的那样支持我。

sentences.en: And that's a hard lesson to learn so young and especially hard when you have adults or people you should know better addressing you in a way that is potentially harmful
sentences.zh: 在这么小的年纪学到这一课很难，尤其是当你面对那些本该更懂事的成年人或其他人，而他们的言行可能对你造成伤害时，

sentences.en: to somebody whose, you know, brain is still growing and developing.
sentences.zh: 对于一个大脑还在成长和发育的人来说，这尤其困难。

sentences.en: Did you watch Quiet on Set, the doc about Nickelodeon child stars?
sentences.zh: 你看过关于尼克频道童星的纪录片《片场静悄悄》吗？

sentences.en: No, I know my mom did and she called me about it a bit, but I didn't sit down and watch the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 没有，我知道我妈妈看过，她还跟我提过一点，但我没有坐下来看完整个片子。

sentences.en: Did it resonate for her?
sentences.zh: 这对她有共鸣吗？

sentences.en: Um, no, it didn't.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没有。

sentences.en: But I had had, before I was on Disney, I had had some experience with Nickelodeon when I was younger and nothing like that.
sentences.zh: 但在我加入迪士尼之前，我小时候确实有过一些在尼克频道的经历，但没有发生过那种事。

sentences.en: I don't know all of the stories, but I can't relate to anything like that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道所有的故事，但我无法与那种事情产生共鸣。

sentences.en: But, uh, she just remembers being really grateful that I ended up, uh, on a different channel or in a different space because obviously we weren't seeing that side of things.
sentences.zh: 但是，她只是记得非常庆幸我最终去了另一个频道或空间，因为显然我们没有看到那一面。

sentences.en: But, um, I think for her, it was just more so pain because she had seen the way that other children maybe weren't protected or weren't as looked at after.
sentences.zh: 但是，我想对她来说，更多的是心痛，因为她看到了其他孩子可能没有受到保护，或者没有得到同样的关照。

sentences.en: She watched over me like a hawk, you know, so I think for her, it was more empathizing and wishing she somehow could have done something to help, you know, that case.
sentences.zh: 她像老鹰一样守护着我，所以我想对她来说，更多的是感同身受，并希望她当时能做些什么来帮助那个案例。

sentences.en: But she just called me saying she was so grateful that things were okay and that she was there to witness everything.
sentences.zh: 但她只是打电话给我说，她非常庆幸一切都好，而且她当时就在现场见证了一切。

sentences.en: Do you think that that's what helps when you're a child actor, having parents that are going to protect you?
sentences.zh: 你认为作为童星，有父母保护会有帮助吗？

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think, I mean, child acting is strange.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我想，童星演艺圈很奇怪。

sentences.en: It is in hindsight.
sentences.zh: 回想起来确实如此。

sentences.en: I see why my parents felt so hesitant about it because, you know, you're putting a child in a, an adult workplace.
sentences.zh: 我明白为什么我父母对此感到犹豫，因为你把一个孩子放进了一个成人的工作场所。

sentences.en: Um, I think if I just stayed growing up in the Coachella Valley, I would be a completely different person.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想如果我一直待在科切拉谷长大，我会成为一个完全不同的人。

sentences.en: I wouldn't speak the way that I do or approach interactions the way that I do.
sentences.zh: 我不会像现在这样说话，也不会用这种方式处理人际关系。

sentences.en: It's completely changed my way of thinking and going about life.
sentences.zh: 这完全改变了我的思维方式和生活方式。

sentences.en: And when I speak to other child actors, I can pick them out instantly because, uh, we kind of all have that.
sentences.zh: 当我和其他童星交谈时，我能一眼认出他们，因为我们都有那种特质。

sentences.en: It's just a very specific, uh, like some secret little, um, language or something like that, that, that we all share.
sentences.zh: 那就像是一种非常特殊的、某种秘密的小语言之类的东西，我们都共享着。

sentences.en: So children aren't supposed to be working like that.
sentences.zh: 孩子们本不应该那样工作的。

sentences.en: They are supposed to be, you know, climbing trees and drawing and, uh, going to school.
sentences.zh: 他们本应该爬树、画画、去上学。

sentences.en: And, you know, some of those kids' parents don't even take school seriously.
sentences.zh: 而且有些孩子的父母甚至不把学校当回事。

sentences.en: So I feel really, really fortunate to have had parents who made sure that I hang out with friends, made sure that I went to public school and wouldn't allow me to work on a
sentences.zh: 所以我感到非常非常幸运，我的父母确保我和朋友们一起玩，确保我上公立学校，并且不允许我接工作，

sentences.en: job unless I had straight A's and was prioritizing my, my sleep and my schoolwork.
sentences.zh: 除非我的成绩全是A，并且优先考虑睡眠和学业。

sentences.en: It's funny when you say that you can pick them out in a room.
sentences.zh: 你说你能一眼认出他们，这很有趣。

sentences.en: What, what is that thing?
sentences.zh: 那是什么样的特质？

sentences.en: Is it like, just like a poise, a precociousness?
sentences.zh: 是那种沉稳、早熟吗？

sentences.en: Yes, yes, uh, poise, precociousness, um, it's hard to say because what I'm finding too is oftentimes we mistake it for maturity and it's not, it's, it's almost a mask.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，沉稳、早熟，很难说，因为我发现我们往往会把它误认为是成熟，其实不是，这几乎是一种伪装。

sentences.en: It's a professionalism that people our age typically aren't equipped with because you're waking up at six in the morning every day and have starting your morning with meetings
sentences.zh: 这是一种我们这个年纪的人通常不具备的职业素养，因为你每天早上六点起床，从会议开始你的一天，

sentences.en: and coffee.
sentences.zh: 还有咖啡。

sentences.en: And I think it's very important to mention that we think it's maturity and it's not.
sentences.zh: 我认为很重要的一点是，我们以为那是成熟，其实不然。

sentences.en: Do you regret it that you chose that path?
sentences.zh: 你后悔选择了那条路吗？

sentences.en: There's times that I regret it.
sentences.zh: 有时候我会后悔。

sentences.en: There's times that my parents regret it.
sentences.zh: 有时候我的父母也会后悔。

sentences.en: Looking back, I, I wouldn't, I wouldn't change anything.
sentences.zh: 回首往事，我，我不会，我不会改变任何事情。

sentences.en: I don't, I don't believe in that because if anything, I'm, I'm incredibly grateful for the lessons that it did teach me and it did teach me so much.
sentences.zh: 我不，我不相信那种说法，因为如果说有什么的话，我，我非常感激它教会我的那些课程，它确实教会了我很多。

sentences.en: And I do love that when I go on a set now, I'm incredibly knowledgeable of the set around me.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实很喜欢现在去片场时，我对周围的一切了如指掌。

sentences.en: I know what the, you know, camera verbiage means.
sentences.zh: 我知道，你知道，摄影术语是什么意思。

sentences.en: I know what a grip job is.
sentences.zh: 我知道场务的工作是什么。

sentences.en: I know what a gaffer's job is.
sentences.zh: 我知道灯光师的工作是什么。

sentences.en: I can get along with the DP.
sentences.zh: 我能和摄影指导相处得很好。

sentences.en: I can go through shot lists.
sentences.zh: 我可以过一遍拍摄清单。

sentences.en: Like I, I, I understand it all.
sentences.zh: 就像我，我，我全都理解。

sentences.en: I know what's going on around me.
sentences.zh: 我知道我周围正在发生什么。

sentences.en: Therefore, I feel incredibly safe and comfortable and excited to go to work every day because it's familiar to me.
sentences.zh: 因此，我感到非常安全、舒适，并且每天都对工作充满期待，因为这一切对我来说很熟悉。

sentences.en: So I guess there's a part of me that as a 21 year old actor now, I'm really, really grateful for that knowledge.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜，作为一个21岁的演员，我内心深处真的，真的非常感激那些知识。

sentences.en: And I wouldn't have had that without that experience.
sentences.zh: 如果没有那段经历，我就不会拥有这些。

sentences.en: Have you talked about it with other former Disney stars?
sentences.zh: 你和其他前迪士尼明星聊过这件事吗？

sentences.en: I'm thinking of like Selena Gomez and others like that who had a similar experience.
sentences.zh: 我在想比如赛琳娜·戈麦斯（Selena Gomez）和其他有类似经历的人。

sentences.en: Not entirely, but I do have a weird habit of connecting with older generation actresses almost instantly.
sentences.zh: 不完全是，但我确实有一个奇怪的习惯，就是几乎能瞬间与老一辈的女演员建立联系。

sentences.en: And I think it's because of that.
sentences.zh: 我想这正是因为那个原因。

sentences.en: There's a certain level of empathy and instant want for protection and, you know, to be able to guide younger, younger people.
sentences.zh: 有一种同理心，以及一种想要保护和，你知道，能够引导更年轻的人的本能。

sentences.en: I've been really, really lucky to work with incredible actresses who definitely had a harder upbringing.
sentences.zh: 我真的很幸运，能与那些成长经历确实更艰难的杰出女演员合作。

sentences.en: They've been teachers.
sentences.zh: 她们是我的老师。

sentences.en: They've been mentors.
sentences.zh: 她们是我的导师。

sentences.en: And that has definitely helped a lot and been really beautiful.
sentences.zh: 这确实帮了我很多，而且非常美好。

sentences.en: Like who?
sentences.zh: 比如谁？

sentences.en: Winona Ryder, of course.
sentences.zh: 薇诺娜·瑞德（Winona Ryder），当然。

sentences.en: She was so warm and welcoming and kind and inviting right from the jump.
sentences.zh: 她从一开始就非常热情、好客、友善且平易近人。

sentences.en: And I couldn't be more grateful.
sentences.zh: 我对此感激不尽。

sentences.en: It was at a time where my career was taking a different turn and I didn't realize that I needed that from somebody who could relate.
sentences.zh: 那是我事业发生转折的时候，我没意识到我需要来自一个能感同身受的人的支持。

sentences.en: But I did.
sentences.zh: 但我确实需要。

sentences.en: The way Winona and I got along was quite weird.
sentences.zh: 我和薇诺娜相处的方式相当奇妙。

sentences.en: It was like we were reading each other's minds a little bit.
sentences.zh: 就像我们能读懂彼此的心思一样。

sentences.en: What advice did she give you?
sentences.zh: 她给了你什么建议？

sentences.en: It's hard to pinpoint.
sentences.zh: 很难具体说出来。

sentences.en: That you'd want to share.
sentences.zh: 你愿意分享的那种。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's hard to pinpoint because I think some of it I would like to keep between us.
sentences.zh: 是啊，很难具体说，因为我觉得有些话我想留在我们之间。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: She just made me feel really, it's almost hard to say because it's hard to believe sometimes.
sentences.zh: 她只是让我感觉真的，这甚至有点难说，因为有时候很难相信。

sentences.en: She made me feel really, really beautiful and special.
sentences.zh: 她让我感觉自己真的很美、很特别。

sentences.en: And that was, again, during that time, it meant the world to me.
sentences.zh: 那同样是在那段时间，对我来说意义重大。

sentences.en: You keep on mentioning that time.
sentences.zh: 你一直在提“那段时间”。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to understand what do you mean that time?
sentences.zh: 我只是想了解你说的“那段时间”是指什么？

sentences.en: It was a very transformative period in my life.
sentences.zh: 那是我生命中一个非常具有变革性的时期。

sentences.en: We shot Beetlejuice not that long after Wednesday had come out.
sentences.zh: 我们在《阴间大法师》（Beetlejuice）上映后不久就拍摄了它。

sentences.en: So, you know, one day I just, I woke up in somebody else's shoes.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，有一天我醒来，发现自己换了个人生。

sentences.en: I felt like I had entered somebody else's life and, like, I didn't know how to get back to mine.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己进入了别人的生活，而且，我不知道该怎么回到我自己的生活。

sentences.en: So she, you know, obviously with the success and attention that she received in the 90s, she had experienced that, known that probably to an even greater extent.
sentences.zh: 所以她，你知道，显然凭借她在90年代获得的成功和关注，她经历过这些，可能了解得更深。

sentences.en: So she was the first person that I connected with on that topic.
sentences.zh: 所以她是第一个我能就这个话题产生共鸣的人。

sentences.en: Or she made me feel seen where, you know, other people necessarily in my life, as much as they wanted to, couldn't relate or couldn't understand.
sentences.zh: 或者说，她让我感到被理解，而你知道，我生命中其他人，尽管他们想理解，却无法感同身受或无法理解。

sentences.en: I mean, it's funny that we've been talking about your Disney days because the stereotype of a Disney star, right, bubbly, precocious,
sentences.zh: 我是说，很有趣，我们一直在谈论你的迪士尼时光，因为迪士尼明星的刻板印象，对吧，活泼、早熟，

sentences.en: is kind of the polar opposite of the roles that you've become famous for as an adult.
sentences.zh: 和你成年后成名的角色截然相反。

sentences.en: Did that shift feel like a conscious one for you?
sentences.zh: 这种转变对你来说是有意识的吗？

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 完全不是。

sentences.en: I remember when I first met with my agent, and we were deciding what we wanted to do after Disney Channel, what was the move.
sentences.zh: 我记得我第一次见经纪人时，我们在决定离开迪士尼频道后想做什么，下一步该怎么走。

sentences.en: She asked if there was any genre or anything specifically that I was looking for.
sentences.zh: 她问我是否有特别想尝试的类型或任何东西。

sentences.en: And I really didn't know what to say.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道该说什么。

sentences.en: I said, I think horror would be cool.
sentences.zh: 我说，我觉得恐怖片会很酷。

sentences.en: And I said that but didn't think much about it.
sentences.zh: 我随口一说，没多想。

sentences.en: And it just so happened that a lot of the opportunities that came my way a few years down the road were primarily horror.
sentences.zh: 结果几年后，我遇到的很多机会主要都是恐怖片。

sentences.en: How I've become the deadpan, dark, brooding teenager, I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 至于我怎么成了那个冷面、阴郁、沉思的青少年，我也不确定。

sentences.en: I mean, well, I can't say that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，好吧，我不能这么说。

sentences.en: Obviously, it's because of Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 显然，这是因为《星期三》（Wednesday）。

sentences.en: Well, you are filming right now the new season of Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你现在正在拍摄《星期三》的新一季。

sentences.en: One of the things that I love about the character of Wednesday is that it gives young girls permission to not be nice.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢《星期三》这个角色的原因之一是，它赋予了年轻女孩“不必讨人喜欢”的权利。

sentences.en: You know, my daughter has a Wednesday mug that says, I don't bury hatchets.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我女儿有一个《星期三》的马克杯，上面写着：我不掩埋仇恨。

sentences.en: I sharpen them.
sentences.zh: 我磨快它们。

sentences.en: Beautiful.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: She's 11.
sentences.zh: 她11岁。

sentences.en: She's cool.
sentences.zh: 她很酷。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think it's a good message for young girls and for women, for all of us, that you don't have to be liked all the time.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为这对年轻女孩和女性，对我们所有人来说，都是一个很好的信息：你不必时刻讨人喜欢。

sentences.en: Is that something that you thought about in the character of Wednesday, that, you know, she had acerbic, sharp edges?
sentences.zh: 你在塑造《星期三》这个角色时，是否考虑过她那种尖刻、锋利的特质？

sentences.en: I think Wednesday has taught me the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得《星期三》也教会了我同样的事情。

sentences.en: She's definitely taught me to be a lot more confident, a lot more headstrong.
sentences.zh: 她确实教会了我变得更加自信，更加固执己见。

sentences.en: I think it's really easy for women to be labeled difficult or, you know, a diva or, you know, just trouble.
sentences.zh: 我认为女性很容易被贴上“难搞”或者，你知道，“大牌”或者，你知道，仅仅是“麻烦”的标签。

sentences.en: And I think that that's ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: It's not a bad thing to be opinionated.
sentences.zh: 有主见并不是坏事。

sentences.en: That's not a nasty, evil thing.
sentences.zh: 那不是一件卑劣、邪恶的事情。

sentences.en: It's so important to have opinions.
sentences.zh: 拥有观点非常重要。

sentences.en: If we didn't have opinions, where the hell would we be?
sentences.zh: 如果我们没有观点，我们到底会变成什么样？

sentences.en: We would get nothing done.
sentences.zh: 我们将一事无成。

sentences.en: It would be a mess.
sentences.zh: 那会是一团糟。

sentences.en: I think everyone should have opinions.
sentences.zh: 我认为每个人都应该有自己的观点。

sentences.en: And I'm glad that Wednesday has ignited that in people.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴《星期三》激发了人们这一点。

sentences.en: You wrote a book when you were 17, and you talk about insecurities, mental health challenges.
sentences.zh: 你在17岁时写了一本书，谈到了不安全感和心理健康挑战。

sentences.en: And you're 21 now.
sentences.zh: 你现在21岁了。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering, since your career blew up, does that make things easier or harder?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，自从你的事业爆发以来，这让事情变得更容易还是更难了？

sentences.en: Much, much harder.
sentences.zh: 难得多，多得多了。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Much harder.
sentences.zh: 难得多。

sentences.en: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: Because I've always been someone who's put an immense amount of pressure on myself.
sentences.zh: 因为我一直是一个对自己施加巨大压力的人。

sentences.en: But it's a bit different when you can't really walk outside without expecting to be pointed at.
sentences.zh: 但当你走在外面，随时可能被人指指点点时，情况就有点不同了。

sentences.en: Or, you know, it's kind of died down now.
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，现在稍微平息了一些。

sentences.en: But still, I walk into a room and I am looking at everything differently.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，我走进一个房间时，看待一切的眼光都不同了。

sentences.en: I know that my position as a public figure has changed immensely.
sentences.zh: 我知道我作为公众人物的地位发生了巨大的变化。

sentences.en: And I was a private person, and I prefer to be a private person.
sentences.zh: 我曾经是一个注重隐私的人，我也更喜欢保持隐私。

sentences.en: So I think understanding that there's a lot more eyes and a lot more people watching.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，要理解现在有更多的目光和更多的人在注视着我。

sentences.en: And I'm so underdeveloped.
sentences.zh: 而且我还没完全成熟。

sentences.en: You know, my prefrontal cortex isn't even fully there yet, technically.
sentences.zh: 你知道，从技术上讲，我的前额叶皮层甚至还没完全发育好。

sentences.en: You know, I want to be making the mistakes and learning from them and falling on my face.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想要犯错，从错误中学习，然后摔跟头。

sentences.en: And maybe the opposite.
sentences.zh: 也许反过来也行。

sentences.en: I want to be extremely confident and try everything and do everything and be the biggest risk taker in the world.
sentences.zh: 我想要极其自信，尝试一切，做一切事情，成为世界上最敢于冒险的人。

sentences.en: There's a lot more at stake now, whether I like it or not.
sentences.zh: 现在赌注大多了，不管我喜不喜欢。

sentences.en: And people are entirely entitled to, you know, share their opinion.
sentences.zh: 人们完全有权，你知道，分享他们的观点。

sentences.en: And even when maybe it's not the most welcome.
sentences.zh: 即使是在可能不那么受欢迎的时候。

sentences.en: But I think it's just kind of, sorry, I'm trying to think of the best way to phrase this or put this in a way that is still refreshing.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这只是，抱歉，我正在努力想出最好的方式来表达这一点，或者以一种仍然令人耳目一新的方式来表述。

sentences.en: You don't have to just say it in the way that you feel it.
sentences.zh: 你不必非要按照你的感受去说出来。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's really scary, actually.
sentences.zh: 是啊，其实真的很可怕。

sentences.en: And it's hard to say that because you can't complain.
sentences.zh: 而且很难说出口，因为你不能抱怨。

sentences.en: You know, I wanted this when I was a child.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我小时候就想要这个。

sentences.en: I live such a privileged life.
sentences.zh: 我过着如此优越的生活。

sentences.en: I'm so lucky to do the things that I do.
sentences.zh: 我真的很幸运能做我现在做的事情。

sentences.en: I love my job.
sentences.zh: 我热爱我的工作。

sentences.en: I don't see myself wanting to stop my job.
sentences.zh: 我没想过要停止我的工作。

sentences.en: There are certain things that no one can really prepare you for, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，有些事情是没人能真正为你做好准备的。

sentences.en: And that kind of attention is one of them.
sentences.zh: 而那种关注就是其中之一。

sentences.en: How do you protect yourself?
sentences.zh: 你如何保护自己？

sentences.en: This is terrible to say because I think my publicist might be listening to this.
sentences.zh: 说这个很糟糕，因为我觉得我的公关可能正在听。

sentences.en: But I do avoid the phone as much as I can.
sentences.zh: 但我确实尽可能地远离手机。

sentences.en: I'm always walking.
sentences.zh: 我一直在走路。

sentences.en: If you're ever wondering what I'm doing, if my parents are ever wondering, if I'm not at work, I'm not on some sort of meeting, I am outside doing laps.
sentences.zh: 如果你想知道我在做什么，如果我父母想知道，如果我不在工作，不在开会，我就是在外面绕圈走。

sentences.en: I'm in a random garden.
sentences.zh: 我在某个随机的花园里。

sentences.en: And I am laying, taking a nap in a field.
sentences.zh: 我在田野里躺着，打个盹。

sentences.en: I hope your publicist likes that.
sentences.zh: 希望你的公关会喜欢这个。

sentences.en: That's beautiful.
sentences.zh: 那太美好了。

sentences.en: I know that's what she likes.
sentences.zh: 我知道她喜欢那样。

sentences.en: And I hope your parents feel the same.
sentences.zh: 也希望你父母有同样的感觉。

sentences.en: Except for when you're trying to book this second phone call to catch up.
sentences.zh: 除了当你试图预约这第二次通话来叙旧的时候。

sentences.en: And it's like, oh, man, where did Jenna go when she can't get a hold of me?
sentences.zh: 就像是，噢，天哪，当联系不上我时，珍娜去哪了？

sentences.en: I guess that's maybe how I protect myself.
sentences.zh: 我想这也许就是我保护自己的方式。

sentences.en: I think it's really easy for, again, maybe I'm like my mom in a lot of ways where maybe I operate out of fear sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很容易，再说一次，也许我在很多方面像我妈妈，有时候我可能是出于恐惧而行事。

sentences.en: And I try not to be that way.
sentences.zh: 我尽量不那样做。

sentences.en: I think I've actually relaxed a lot in recent years because I've given up.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我最近几年其实放松了很多，因为我放弃了。

sentences.en: And I don't mean that in a sad way.
sentences.zh: 我不是在悲伤的意义上说这个。

sentences.en: I mean that in the most liberating way possible.
sentences.zh: 我是以一种尽可能解放的方式说的。

sentences.en: I think I'm really working on not being so self-critical or just killing myself over things that in the grand scheme of the world with the news and things you see,
sentences.zh: 我觉得我真的在努力不再那么自我批评，或者不再为了那些在宏观世界里，看着新闻和各种事情时，

sentences.en: it's really just not, it's not important at all.
sentences.zh: 其实根本就不重要的事情而折磨自己。

sentences.en: I should be having so much fun right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在应该玩得很开心才对。

sentences.en: So much fun.
sentences.zh: 玩得非常开心。

sentences.en: And I don't.
sentences.zh: 但我没有。

sentences.en: And I should.
sentences.zh: 我本应该开心的。

sentences.en: And I try to remind myself of that.
sentences.zh: 我试着提醒自己这一点。

sentences.en: Jenna, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: And I hope you will pick up the phone when I call you again.
sentences.zh: 希望下次我再打给你时，你会接电话。

sentences.en: Well, I will for you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我会为你接的。

sentences.en: But that's only because I like you and I like your daughter.
sentences.zh: 但这只是因为我喜欢你，也喜欢你的女儿。

sentences.en: After the break, I call Jenna back to talk more about the pressures of growing up in public.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我将回拨给珍娜，聊聊更多关于在公众视野下成长的压力。

sentences.en: I don't like to mess up.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢搞砸。

sentences.en: I do it all the time.
sentences.zh: 但我总是搞砸。

sentences.en: And it's embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 而且这很尴尬。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是Winnalou。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的一款拼图游戏，叫《Connections》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你们刚才听到的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 即可从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: How you been?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: I've been good.
sentences.zh: 我一直很好。

sentences.en: I've been very good.
sentences.zh: 我过得非常好。

sentences.en: Busy?
sentences.zh: 忙吗？

sentences.en: Busy.
sentences.zh: 很忙。

sentences.en: Last week was chaos, but I had, it was been holiday here in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 上周简直乱成一团，不过爱尔兰正好放假。

sentences.en: So me and my friends went to the north of Ireland for the three days and just swam in the sea and slept and ate and went on hikes.
sentences.zh: 我和朋友去了爱尔兰北部待了三天，我们就在海里游泳、睡觉、吃饭、徒步旅行。

sentences.en: It was perfect.
sentences.zh: 那真是太完美了。

sentences.en: It was just what I needed right before this big, crazy press store.
sentences.zh: 这正是我在这次大型疯狂媒体宣传活动前所需要的。

sentences.en: So when we ended our conversation last week, it was a little bit of a somber note.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们上周结束谈话时，气氛有点沉重。

sentences.en: And I was thinking about the tension of being a young person and being famous.
sentences.zh: 我当时在想，作为一个年轻人又要出名，这种张力有多大。

sentences.en: And you seem like quite a private person who really needs to kind of guard that privacy.
sentences.zh: 你看起来是个相当注重隐私的人，确实需要守护那种隐私。

sentences.en: But then there's also this desire for you to be this public person, to answer questions, to have all these people look up to you and want things from you.
sentences.zh: 但同时，人们又渴望你成为一个公众人物，去回答问题，让所有人都仰望你、对你有所求。

sentences.en: And I was wondering how you, at 21, figure how much of yourself to share.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，21岁的你是如何权衡该分享多少自我的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Well, something that I want to make very clear is, well, I am an actor and, well, that sort of attention, it is so heavy and it is so intense.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想明确一点，我是一名演员，那种关注度确实非常沉重，非常强烈。

sentences.en: But, you know, oftentimes you get the, oh, well, you should expect it.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，人们经常会说：“哦，你应该预料到这些。”

sentences.en: Oh, well, now you're complaining.
sentences.zh: “哦，现在你在抱怨了。”

sentences.en: Oh, well, why don't you do this instead?
sentences.zh: “哦，你为什么不换个做法？”

sentences.en: Or why don't you stop?
sentences.zh: 或者“你为什么不干脆停下来？”

sentences.en: And, you know, which is true, you could say that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这话没错，你可以这么说。

sentences.en: But I think what I'm trying to say when I say that is not that I'm ungrateful, but more so that you can expect something and try to prepare yourself for something as best you can.
sentences.zh: 但我说这些并不是因为我不感恩，而是因为你可以预料到某些事情，并尽力做好准备。

sentences.en: But you just don't know until you go through it.
sentences.zh: 但除非你亲身经历，否则你根本不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: It's the same thing about, you know, oh, I could easily drive a car.
sentences.zh: 就像那句老话，哦，我可以轻松地开车。

sentences.en: You know, when you're a kid, you think, oh, that's easy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你还是个孩子时，你会想，哦，那很简单。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, I'll look so cool.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你知道，我会看起来很酷。

sentences.en: I'll do it with one hand.
sentences.zh: 我会单手开车。

sentences.en: I'll do it with my knees, you know, and then you get behind a car and it's terrifying.
sentences.zh: 我会用膝盖开车，你知道，但当你真正坐到驾驶座上时，那简直太可怕了。

sentences.en: But for the most part, like, I'm 21, so also don't, I can't be expected to go out there and be a philosopher or be some, you know, almighty being because, yeah,
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，我才21岁，所以别指望我能表现得像个哲学家或者什么全能的神，因为，是的，

sentences.en: I'm a 21-year-old kid.
sentences.zh: 我只是个21岁的孩子。

sentences.en: And I think that's also probably important to remember.
sentences.zh: 我认为记住这一点也很重要。

sentences.en: I remember my 20s being really,
sentences.zh: 我记得我的20多岁过得真的，

sentences.en: really hard because you are leaving one stage of your life and going into another and it felt really fraught and it felt really uncomfortable a lot of the time.
sentences.zh: 真的很难，因为你正在离开人生的一个阶段进入另一个阶段，这感觉非常令人焦虑，而且大部分时间都让人感到很不舒服。

sentences.en: You're becoming an adult.
sentences.zh: 你正在成为一个成年人。

sentences.en: And I was thinking about you having to do that in the public eye.
sentences.zh: 我在想你必须在公众视野下经历这一切。

sentences.en: I mean, does it feel scary?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这感觉可怕吗？

sentences.en: Of course it feels scary.
sentences.zh: 当然感觉可怕。

sentences.en: It feels scary regardless.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这都让人感到害怕。

sentences.en: I get scared when I wake up, you know, I don't know what to do with myself.
sentences.zh: 我醒来时也会感到害怕，你知道，我不知道该拿自己怎么办。

sentences.en: And there's a big part of me that's frustrated by it because people reflect on 20s like some beautiful time, which I can't speak for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我内心很大一部分对此感到沮丧，因为人们把20多岁看作一段美好的时光，我不能代表所有人。

sentences.en: Obviously, some people may have had an incredible time.
sentences.zh: 显然，有些人可能过得非常棒。

sentences.en: Some people may have had a shitty time.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能过得很糟糕。

sentences.en: And what I find most is, you know, it's that thing where, you know, you can't appreciate where you're at right now.
sentences.zh: 我发现最常见的情况是，你知道，就是那种你无法欣赏当下所处阶段的感觉。

sentences.en: So you look back on things and you go, oh, man, the 20s, that was such a good time.
sentences.zh: 所以当你回首往事时，你会说，天哪，20多岁，那真是段好时光。

sentences.en: You know, I was young.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那时我年轻。

sentences.en: I was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我漂亮。

sentences.en: You know, it was the best I had ever looked and this and that, whatever you want to say.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是我颜值巅峰，诸如此类，随你怎么说。

sentences.en: But ultimately, no, you were terrified.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，不，你当时其实很害怕。

sentences.en: I know you were because that's what I'm going through right now.
sentences.zh: 我知道你当时很害怕，因为我现在正经历着这些。

sentences.en: There's no way that you're learning how to pay bills for the first time and dealing with taxes and being expected to be an adult and not be scared shitless.
sentences.zh: 你不可能在第一次学习付账单、处理税务、被要求成为一个成年人的同时，还不被吓得半死。

sentences.en: That's it's just a given.
sentences.zh: 这是理所当然的。

sentences.en: So maybe there's something exciting about that.
sentences.zh: 所以也许这其中也有一些令人兴奋的地方。

sentences.en: But no, it's not nice because.
sentences.zh: 但说实话，这并不好受，因为。

sentences.en: I don't like to mess up.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢搞砸事情。

sentences.en: I do it all the time and it's embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 我总是搞砸，这很尴尬。

sentences.en: What does messing up mean to you?
sentences.zh: 对你来说，“搞砸”意味着什么？

sentences.en: To me, it's really frustrating when I don't communicate the way that I intend to or I'm not able to, you know, fix a situation.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，当我无法按预期进行沟通，或者无法解决某个情况时，我会感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: Could be in my control, could not be in my control.
sentences.zh: 这可能在我的控制范围内，也可能不在。

sentences.en: I feel really, really bad when I can't manage to do what I feel to be simple things.
sentences.zh: 当我无法完成那些我觉得很简单的事情时，我会感到非常非常糟糕。

sentences.en: Like it could be anything.
sentences.zh: 比如任何事情都可能。

sentences.en: I could.
sentences.zh: 我可以。

sentences.en: You're a perfectionist, do you think?
sentences.zh: 你是个完美主义者吗？

sentences.en: I can't even call myself that, but my family and friends do.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不敢这么称呼自己，但我的家人和朋友都这么说。

sentences.en: It's just, you know, everything, everything is, everything could be better.
sentences.zh: 只是，你知道，一切，一切都是，一切都可以做得更好。

sentences.en: I could be doing everything better.
sentences.zh: 我本可以把每件事都做得更好。

sentences.en: So I'm thinking about you trying to be the best representation of whatever it is or not offending people.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在想，你试图成为某种事物的最佳代表，或者尽量不去冒犯他人。

sentences.en: And there was something that you said in a recent interview about the expectations on you as a representative of your culture.
sentences.zh: 你在最近的一次采访中提到过作为文化代表所承受的期望。

sentences.en: As a Latina, it made me upset that there's this idea that there's one way to be Latino.
sentences.zh: 作为一名拉丁裔，那种认为“拉丁裔只有一种活法”的观念让我感到难过。

sentences.en: And I wondered how you deal with that, you know, trying to represent an entire community, but also feeling like maybe you can't represent an entire community.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你是如何处理这个问题的，你知道，既要代表整个群体，又觉得也许你无法代表整个群体。

sentences.en: It's very clear I'm not going to satisfy everybody.
sentences.zh: 很明显，我不可能让每个人都满意。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of pressure, but I've learned to make it less of an external pressure and more of an internal.
sentences.zh: 压力很大，但我已经学会了将这种压力从外部转化为内部。

sentences.en: Our culture, my culture, my Mexican and Puerto Rican heritage, it's so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我们的文化，我的文化，我的墨西哥和波多黎各血统，它是如此美丽。

sentences.en: The stories to come from it are amazing.
sentences.zh: 源于此的故事非常精彩。

sentences.en: I have so many incredible relatives and just insane, surreal experiences that, you know, I've heard and have been passed down.
sentences.zh: 我有许多了不起的亲戚，还有那些疯狂、超现实的经历，你知道，我听过并流传下来的那些。

sentences.en: And I want to be as close to that as possible.
sentences.zh: 我想尽可能地贴近这些。

sentences.en: I do want to speak Spanish.
sentences.zh: 我的确想说西班牙语。

sentences.en: I do, you know, I want to be more connected to my culture.
sentences.zh: 我确实，你知道，我想与我的文化建立更深的联系。

sentences.en: The difference is now I want to do that for me and not for other people, which I think is incredibly important, making that distinction and being aware of it.
sentences.zh: 不同之处在于，现在我想为自己这样做，而不是为了别人，我认为这非常重要，要做出这种区分并意识到这一点。

sentences.en: But, I mean, when you say you want to do it for you and connect more for yourself, what does that entail?
sentences.zh: 但是，当你说是为了自己而想建立更多联系时，这意味着什么？

sentences.en: What does that look like?
sentences.zh: 那是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, I have, my tia Emma is really, really important to me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的艾玛姨妈对我来说非常非常重要。

sentences.en: She's kind of a grandmother to me.
sentences.zh: 她对我来说就像祖母一样。

sentences.en: You know, she lives with my mom now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她现在和我妈妈住在一起。

sentences.en: And I think it's really important that because I'm seeing her so much more often, I want to be able to connect with her as much as I possibly can.
sentences.zh: 我认为这非常重要，因为我见到她的次数多了很多，我想尽可能多地与她交流。

sentences.en: And part of that is, I think, would be being able to connect with her in her native tongue.
sentences.zh: 我认为其中一部分就是能够用她的母语与她交流。

sentences.en: So when I go home, I want to be able to have all those conversations with her and have that intimacy.
sentences.zh: 所以当我回家时，我想能和她进行所有那些对话，拥有那种亲密感。

sentences.en: Because I love her so much.
sentences.zh: 因为我非常爱她。

sentences.en: And now with, you know, how close she is, I want to be even closer.
sentences.zh: 现在既然她离我这么近，我想变得更亲近。

sentences.en: So you're learning Spanish.
sentences.zh: 所以你在学习西班牙语。

sentences.en: Yes, I mean, I am, but also simultaneously I'm not.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，我在学，但同时我也没在学。

sentences.en: I find myself doing the thing where I pick it up and then I put it down, pick it up, and then I put it down.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己总是这样，拿起书本学一会儿，然后又放下，拿起，又放下。

sentences.en: Which is hard with my job because it's so much studying.
sentences.zh: 这在我的工作中很难，因为需要学习的东西太多了。

sentences.en: But 100%, I watch videos in Spanish.
sentences.zh: 但百分之百，我会看西班牙语视频。

sentences.en: I read articles in Spanish.
sentences.zh: 我读西班牙语文章。

sentences.en: I do all of that because I think it's best to kind of keep myself aware and up to date and make sure that I can figure things out.
sentences.zh: 我做所有这些，因为我认为保持清醒和与时俱进，确保自己能弄明白事情是最好的。

sentences.en: If I spoke Spanish to you, would my grammar be all over the place?
sentences.zh: 如果我用西班牙语和你说话，我的语法会乱七八糟吗？
百分之百会。

sentences.en: Would my Tia Emma make fun of me?
sentences.zh: 艾玛姨妈会取笑我吗？

sentences.en: Of course she would.
sentences.zh: 她当然会。

sentences.en: But I think she would also be charmed by the fact that I was trying.
sentences.zh: 但我认为她也会因为我在努力而感到欣慰。

sentences.en: And if that brings her joy, of course I'm going to try.
sentences.zh: 如果这能给她带来快乐，我当然会尝试。

sentences.en: That's what matters.
sentences.zh: 那才是最重要的。

sentences.en: A few more questions.
sentences.zh: 再问几个问题。

sentences.en: One of your next big projects is an adaptation of the Ishiguro novel Clara and the Sun.
sentences.zh: 你接下来的大项目之一是改编石黑一雄的小说《克拉拉与太阳》。

sentences.en: It's a sci-fi story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个科幻故事。

sentences.en: You are playing a robot.
sentences.zh: 你在里面扮演一个机器人。

sentences.en: Why did you want to go do that?
sentences.zh: 你为什么想去演这个？

sentences.en: I had a really great meeting with Taika Waititi.
sentences.zh: 我和塔伊加·维迪提有过一次非常棒的会面。

sentences.en: And he tends to work with a lot of his friends and family.
sentences.zh: 他倾向于和许多朋友和家人一起工作。

sentences.en: So the environment is really safe and comfortable.
sentences.zh: 所以环境非常安全和舒适。

sentences.en: The character Clara, what he had in mind for her is she's artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 关于克拉拉这个角色，他心目中的设定是她是一个人工智能。

sentences.en: And she's basically bought by this mother to befriend a young girl who's dying.
sentences.zh: 她基本上是被一位母亲买来陪伴一个垂死的年轻女孩的。

sentences.en: She's sick.
sentences.zh: 她生病了。

sentences.en: Like, I knew that Clara had just a pure, completely innocent, untainted optimism about her that you can't find in a person.
sentences.zh: 我知道克拉拉身上有一种纯粹、完全天真、未受污染的乐观，这是你在现实中找不到的。

sentences.en: Not a person of that age.
sentences.zh: 在这个年纪的人身上找不到。

sentences.en: Eventually you get older and you're a bit jaded or a bit scarred by certain things.
sentences.zh: 最终你会长大，你会变得有点愤世嫉俗，或者被某些事情伤害过。

sentences.en: You know, you've learned a lot.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你学到了很多。

sentences.en: You've maybe built a bit more of a wall.
sentences.zh: 你可能已经筑起了一道更高的墙。

sentences.en: Clara didn't have that wall.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉没有那道墙。

sentences.en: Which is the complete opposite of a lot of the other characters I play where, you know, they hide who they are or they don't want their emotion to be seen.
sentences.zh: 这和我扮演的其他许多角色完全相反，你知道，他们隐藏真实的自己，或者不想让别人看到他们的情绪。

sentences.en: I just felt like it was a good place to be vulnerable and try something new.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这是一个展现脆弱并尝试新事物的好机会。

sentences.en: What do you think of AI?
sentences.zh: 你觉得人工智能怎么样？

sentences.en: I hate AI.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌人工智能。

sentences.en: I mean, here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，问题是这样的。

sentences.en: Here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 问题是这样的。

sentences.en: AI could be used for incredible things.
sentences.zh: 人工智能可以被用于不可思议的事情。

sentences.en: I think I saw something the other day where they were saying that artificial intelligence was able to detect breast cancer four years before it progressed.
sentences.zh: 我前几天看到一则消息，说人工智能能够在乳腺癌恶化前四年就检测出来。

sentences.en: That's beautiful.
sentences.zh: 那太美好了。

sentences.en: Let's keep it to that.
sentences.zh: 让我们保持在那个层面吧。

sentences.en: Did I like being 14 and making a Twitter account because I was supposed to and seeing dirty edited content of me as a child?
sentences.zh: 我喜欢14岁时因为被要求而注册推特账号，然后看到关于我童年的肮脏剪辑内容吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不喜欢。

sentences.en: It's terrifying.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: It's corrupt.
sentences.zh: 这是腐败的。

sentences.en: It's wrong.
sentences.zh: 这是错误的。

sentences.en: It's disgusting.
sentences.zh: 这是令人作呕的。

sentences.en: And we've opened—here's the problem, though.
sentences.zh: 我们已经打开了——但问题就在这里。

sentences.en: We've opened Pandora's box.
sentences.zh: 我们已经打开了潘多拉魔盒。

sentences.en: Well, it is what it is.
sentences.zh: 好吧，事已至此。

sentences.en: It's out there now.
sentences.zh: 事情已经传开了。

sentences.en: We're going to have to deal with the consequences.
sentences.zh: 我们只能去面对后果。

sentences.en: I would like it to be used with good intent, but we could say that about anything and everything.
sentences.zh: 我希望它能被用于善意，但我们对任何事物都可以这么说。

sentences.en: You saw AI images of you, generated images of you as a child, like pornographic ones?
sentences.zh: 你看到过那些AI生成的你的照片吗？比如你小时候的照片，甚至是色情照片？

sentences.en: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: One of the first—actually, the first DM that I ever opened myself when I was 12 was an unsolicited photo of a man's genitals, and that was just the beginning of what was to come.
sentences.zh: 我12岁时第一次亲自打开的私信，其实就是一张陌生男人的生殖器照片，而那仅仅是噩梦的开始。

sentences.en: I used to have that Twitter account, and I was told that, oh, you've got to do it.
sentences.zh: 我以前有个推特账号，当时有人跟我说，哦，你必须得经营它。

sentences.en: You've got to build your image.
sentences.zh: 你必须建立自己的形象。

sentences.en: I ended up deleting it about two or three years ago because the influx after the show had come out of these absurd images and photos were just so repulsive,
sentences.zh: 两三年前我把它注销了，因为剧集播出后，涌入了太多荒谬的图片和照片，实在太令人作呕了，

sentences.en: and I already was in a confused state that I just deleted it because it was unnecessary, and I didn't need that.
sentences.zh: 当时我已经感到很困惑，所以干脆注销了，因为那根本没必要，我不需要那些东西。

sentences.en: I just can't imagine how disturbing that must have been.
sentences.zh: 我简直无法想象那有多令人不安。

sentences.en: Yeah, I didn't want to—on Twitter, I would make political— political statements or just personal ones or just talk about excitement for jobs,
sentences.zh: 是啊，我不想——在推特上，我会发表一些政治声明，或者只是个人的感言，又或者谈谈对工作的期待，

sentences.en: and then I was graded with this stuff, and it was just disgusting, and it made me feel bad.
sentences.zh: 结果却迎来了那些东西，这真的很恶心，让我感觉很糟糕。

sentences.en: It made me feel uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 让我感到很不舒服。

sentences.en: It's awful, and it's—anyway, that's why, yeah, I deleted it because I couldn't say anything without saying something like that, and I don't need to be saying that every day.
sentences.zh: 这太糟糕了，总之，这就是我注销账号的原因，因为我无论说什么都会引来那种东西，我没必要每天都面对这些。

sentences.en: So one day I just woke up, and I thought, oh, I don't need this anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以有一天我醒来时心想，哦，我不再需要这个了。

sentences.en: So I dropped it.
sentences.zh: 于是我就把它删了。

sentences.en: I guess you've learned how to protect yourself or are learning.
sentences.zh: 我想你已经学会了如何保护自己，或者正在学习中。

sentences.en: I'm learning.
sentences.zh: 我正在学习。

sentences.en: And I guess just in the bigger picture, how would you describe this moment at 21 when you have been exposed to so much already?
sentences.zh: 我想从大局来看，你如何描述21岁这个阶段？毕竟你已经经历过这么多事情了？

sentences.en: I'm just navigating.
sentences.zh: 我只是在摸索。

sentences.en: I think I'm exploring.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我还在探索。

sentences.en: I'm on this sort of personal expedition.
sentences.zh: 我正处于某种个人的探索之旅中。

sentences.en: I guess is the best way that I could put it.
sentences.zh: 我想这是我能想到的最好的表达方式。

sentences.en: I'm on my own little personal expedition.
sentences.zh: 我正在进行属于我自己的小小探索之旅。

sentences.en: So you're turning 22 at the end of September.
sentences.zh: 你九月底就要满22岁了。

sentences.en: Any plans?
sentences.zh: 有什么计划吗？

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 完全没有。

sentences.en: Probably work.
sentences.zh: 大概会工作吧。

sentences.en: I have spent every single birthday of mine since I was 11 on set, except for my 21St.
sentences.zh: 除了21岁生日那次，我从11岁开始的每一个生日都是在片场度过的。

sentences.en: That was the first time in 10 years that I had not been on set on my birthday.
sentences.zh: 那是我十年来第一次没在片场过生日。

sentences.en: So I've never been big on birthdays, and I'm back at work this time.
sentences.zh: 所以我对生日向来没什么特别的感觉，这次我又得回去工作了。

sentences.en: So nothing crazy planned.
sentences.zh: 所以没什么特别的计划。

sentences.en: I am probably just going to want to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我可能只想睡觉。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就这样。
